import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
china = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[73.5, 18.2], [135.0, 18.2], [135.0, 53.6], [73.5, 53.6], [73.5, 18.2]]]
)

# 2. Data Acquisition using MODIS NDVI as proxy for green leaf area
def mask_modis_quality(image):
    qa = image.select('SummaryQA')
    mask = qa.eq(0)  # 0 = good quality
    return image.updateMask(mask)

# 2000 data
col_2000 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13A1') \
    .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31') \
    .filterBounds(china) \
    .map(mask_modis_quality) \
    .select('NDVI')

size_2000 = col_2000.size().getInfo()
print(f"2000 Images: {size_2000}")

if size_2000 == 0:
    print("No data for 2000.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 2017 data
col_2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13A1') \
    .filterDate('2017-01-01', '2017-12-31') \
    .filterBounds(china) \
    .map(mask_modis_quality) \
    .select('NDVI')

size_2017 = col_2017.size().getInfo()
print(f"2017 Images: {size_2017}")

if size_2017 == 0:
    print("No data for 2017.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI for each year
mean_2000 = col_2000.mean()
mean_2017 = col_2017.mean()

# 4. Calculate statistics with pixel count validation
stats_2000 = mean_2000.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=china,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

stats_2017 = mean_2017.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=china,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

ndvi_2000 = stats_2000.get('NDVI_mean')
count_2000 = stats_2000.get('NDVI_count')
ndvi_2017 = stats_2017.get('NDVI_mean')
count_2017 = stats_2017.get('NDVI_count')

print(f"2000 NDVI: {ndvi_2000}, Pixels: {count_2000}")
print(f"2017 NDVI: {ndvi_2017}, Pixels: {count_2017}")

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if count_2000 == 0 or count_2017 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif ndvi_2000 is None or ndvi_2017 is None:
    print("Calculation failed - null values.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif ndvi_2000 < -1 or ndvi_2000 > 1 or ndvi_2017 < -1 or ndvi_2017 > 1:
    print("Invalid NDVI range.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif ndvi_2017 > ndvi_2000:
    print(f"Green leaf area increased: {ndvi_2000:.4f} -> {ndvi_2017:.4f}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Green leaf area did not increase: {ndvi_2000:.4f} -> {ndvi_2017:.4f}")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
china = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[73.5, 18.2], [135.0, 18.2], [135.0, 53.6], [73.5, 53.6], [73.5, 18.2]]]
)

# 2. Data Acquisition using MODIS NDVI as proxy for green leaf area
def mask_and_scale_modis(image):
    qa = image.select('SummaryQA')
    mask = qa.eq(0)  # 0 = good quality
    ndvi = image.select('NDVI').multiply(0.0001)  # Scale factor
    return ndvi.updateMask(mask)

# 2000 data
col_2000 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13A1') \
    .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31') \
    .filterBounds(china) \
    .map(mask_and_scale_modis)

size_2000 = col_2000.size().getInfo()
print(f"2000 Images: {size_2000}")

if size_2000 == 0:
    print("No data for 2000.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 2017 data
col_2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13A1') \
    .filterDate('2017-01-01', '2017-12-31') \
    .filterBounds(china) \
    .map(mask_and_scale_modis)

size_2017 = col_2017.size().getInfo()
print(f"2017 Images: {size_2017}")

if size_2017 == 0:
    print("No data for 2017.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI for each year
mean_2000 = col_2000.mean()
mean_2017 = col_2017.mean()

# 4. Calculate statistics with pixel count validation
stats_2000 = mean_2000.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=china,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

stats_2017 = mean_2017.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=china,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

ndvi_2000 = stats_2000.get('NDVI_mean')
count_2000 = stats_2000.get('NDVI_count')
ndvi_2017 = stats_2017.get('NDVI_mean')
count_2017 = stats_2017.get('NDVI_count')

print(f"2000 Stats - NDVI: {ndvi_2000}, Pixels: {count_2000}")
print(f"2017 Stats - NDVI: {ndvi_2017}, Pixels: {count_2017}")

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if count_2000 == 0 or count_2017 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif ndvi_2000 is None or ndvi_2017 is None:
    print("Calculation failed - null values.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif ndvi_2000 < -1 or ndvi_2000 > 1 or ndvi_2017 < -1 or ndvi_2017 > 1:
    print(f"Invalid NDVI range: 2000={ndvi_2000:.4f}, 2017={ndvi_2017:.4f}")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif ndvi_2017 > ndvi_2000:
    increase_pct = ((ndvi_2017 - ndvi_2000) / ndvi_2000) * 100
    print(f"Green leaf area increased: {ndvi_2000:.4f} -> {ndvi_2017:.4f} (+{increase_pct:.1f}%)")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Green leaf area did not increase: {ndvi_2000:.4f} -> {ndvi_2017:.4f}")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
